## AUTOMATION RUNNER
Every minute: read the **Automations** sheet, pick rows whose next_run is due,
reschedule them (idempotency: the slot is claimed before firing), and call the
Brain in AUTOMATION mode with the stored payload as the only source of truth.
Set the Brain id in **Call Rayah Brain (AUTOMATION)**; needs the Automations tab + RAYAH_SHEET_ID.
